id.description: Can be either a note ID or a hashtag prefixed tag name

weight.description: Optional weight for the note node, rounded to 1 decimal place

source.description: The ID of the source node (note id or hashtag prefixed tag name)

target.description: The ID of the target node (note id or hashtag prefixed tag name)
